notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Strionic Resonator and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Corridor Monitor token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
